# telnyx_agent_gateway_guardrails (Data Source)

Lists agent gateway guardrails, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_agent_gateway_guardrail`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) The instance id.

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `agent_gateway_guardrails` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_gateway_guardrails))

<a id="nestedatt--agent_gateway_guardrails"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agent_gateway_guardrails`

Read-Only:

- `always_on` (Boolean) Whether it runs on every request.
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Identifies the guardrail.
- `modes` (Set of String) When the guardrail runs.
- `name` (String) What a request names in its `guardrails` field.
- `settings` (String, Sensitive) The type's settings. `content_filter`: `patterns` (prebuilt patterns by name, such as `us_ssn` or `email`), `regexes`, `keywords`, and `categories` (such as `prompt_injection`), each with an `action` of `block` or `mask`. `tool_permission`: `rules` (`id`, `tool_name`, `tool_type`, `decision`, `argument_patterns`), a `default` decision, and `on_denied` (`block` or `rewrite`). `model_judge`: a `model` on the instance and weighted `criteria` (`name`, `description`, `weight`, the weights summing to 100). `custom_code`: `code` defining `apply_guardrail(inputs, request_data, input_type)`. `lakera`: `api_key`, `project_id`, `api_base`. `presidio`: `analyzer_url`, `anonymizer_url`, `entities` (entity name to `block` or `mask`), `language`. `bedrock`: `guardrail_id`, `version`, `region`, and `access_key_id` with `secret_access_key`, or `role_name`. `azure_content_safety`: `api_key`, `endpoint`, `severity` (0 to 7). Provider secrets are write-only. Responses leave the secrets out. A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
